messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Aarav Mehta
Pune, India | aarav.mehta@example.com | +91 98200 11111

SUMMARY
Backend engineer with four years of experience building payment and ledger services.
Enjoys owning services end to end, from design review to on-call.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Java, Kotlin, Go, SQL
Frameworks: Spring Boot, gRPC, Hibernate
Data: PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Kafka, Redis
Cloud: AWS (ECS, SQS, DynamoDB), Terraform

EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer, Razorpay (2022 - Present)
Designed an idempotent double-entry ledger processing 3 million transactions per day.
Cut p99 settlement latency from 900ms to 180ms by moving reconciliation to Kafka consumers.
Mentored two junior engineers and ran the payments on-call rotation.

Software Engineer, Infosys (2020 - 2022)
Built REST APIs in Spring Boot for a banking client's loan origination workflow.
Wrote the batch job that migrated 40 million customer records from Oracle to PostgreSQL.

PROJECTS
RateGuard: a distributed rate limiter in Go using Redis sliding windows.
LedgerLens: an open-source tool that diffs ledger snapshots to find reconciliation breaks.

EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Engineering, College of Engineering Pune, 2020, CGPA 8.6

CERTIFICATIONS
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (2023)

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
